description: Maintainer-style tasks against this repository. Each task lists the files a maintainer would open first; paths are relative to the project root.

tasks.query: classify a chunk as json, code, log or diff before crushing it
the prompt injection scanner should flag a new pattern

search the memory history for past decisions
